categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls squarely under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), with no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories applicable.
